description: Implementation of FundReadPlatformService for accessing fund data from the database, including methods to retrieve all funds and a specific fund by ID.

classes.name: FundReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing fund data retrieval logic, including caching and exception handling.

classes.name: FundMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to FundData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllFunds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all funds, with caching based on tenant identifier.

methods.name: retrieveFund
methods.description: Retrieves a specific fund by its ID, throws FundNotFoundException if not found.
